# nas-movie-cli

> Self-hosted TypeScript CLI that turns a home NAS into an automatic JAV library: follows bookmarked actresses on JavDB, sends the best magnet to the NAS's Thunder (迅雷) downloader, renames finished files to "YYYY-MM-DD CODE Actress.ext" and serves a LAN library wall. Also subscribes to TV series and anime. MIT licensed.

- Runs on: Linux NAS with systemd user services (tested on UGREEN UGOS), Node.js 18+, Thunder NAS API on 127.0.0.1:5050.
- Metadata: public JavDB app endpoints and javdb.com movie pages; no JavDB account.
- Magnets: javdb.com movie page first, sukebei RSS fallback; queried from 1 day before release, daily for 14 days, then weekly.
- Schedule: catalog 03:00, shows check 04:00, shows organize 08:00/20:00, organize 15:00, teachers auto 18:00.
- Naming: all female cast, up to 4 names joined with 、 then 等; unknown names re-checked from cache every run.
- Failure policy: any source or submission failure exits with code 1.

- Agent install: `npm install -g github:OceanJy333/nas-movie-cli`, or `npx skills add OceanJy333/nas-movie-cli` for the skill; every command prints JSON and needs `--apply` to change anything.
